messages:
Maria (sales): Quick check — EdgeBank is asking for a sandbox POC. What's the absolute minimal access we can hand to their devs to test embeddings + generation? Prefer hosted for speed but they may ask for Dedicated/VPC later. Need least-privilege and any pricing caveats. CC @Priya
Priya (solutions): Hosted is fastest. Recommend: create a workspace invite for their devs, role=developer, and issue a scoped API key that only allows inference:generate + inference:embeddings. Short expiry (7d) and an RPS cap. If they need network isolation, escalate to Dedicated or Private/VPC.
Tom (eng-infra): For hosted scoped key we typically create a policy like this (example):
```json
{
  "scopes": ["inference:generate", "inference:embeddings"],
  "resources": ["workspaces/edgebank/sandbox"],
  "expiry": "7d",
  "rate_limit": "5rps"
}
```
We then store the key in the secure vault and share only via a gated channel. For Dedicated: need PO with billing and a capacity ticket.
Elaine (security): Quick security checklist: do they plan to send production PII? If yes, Hosted may be problematic unless they redact. For Dedicated/VPC we can offer customer-managed KMS and audit logs. Also require signed DPA/NDA before sharing any network diagrams or sample subnets.
Jason (sales-engineer): Pricing note for Maria: Hosted POC usage = standard per-token + embeddings rate. If they want predictable throughput for load testing, Dedicated pool has a monthly minimum (we can give a 30-day eval credit but need approval). I'll pull the numbers and paste them here.
infra-bot: Ticket INFR-4821 created: "EdgeBank sandbox access + scoped API key" — assignee @Tom.
Maria (sales): Thanks. Can someone provision the scoped key and invite these users: alice@edgebank.com, bob@edgebank.com — dev role only. Also want a safe way to give them a test prompt set for evaluations.
Tom (eng-infra): On it. I created the invites (alice, bob) and added them to workspace edgebank-sandbox as "Developer". I generated a scoped key id sk-***234. Full key posted to #secure-sales-keys (restricted). Rotation: set to expire in 7 days, can extend after POC.
Elaine (security): Confirming we also need the signed NDA before we provide the Dedicated/VPC network info. If they want inbound IP allowlist, we need their egress IPs and SAML config for SSO mapping.
Jason (sales-engineer): Maria — FYI I attached a quick cost estimate in the thread: hosted ~= $0.0006/token for gen tier + $0.001/embedding unit for small batches. Dedicated example: 1xA100 pool reserved = $X/month (I'll DM finance for an exact quote).
Maria (sales): Perfect. I'll get the NDA routed and ping them to confirm no production PII. Can we also add telemetry for token-level cost per request for the sandbox? Want to show economics to the buyer.
Tom (eng-infra): Added a lightweight per-route tracing label for the sandbox so you can see token delta in console for each API key. Will be visible in 5-10m.
Elaine (security): One more: set API key scope to disallow model-management and billing endpoints. Only inference and embeddings.
Priya (solutions): We should include a short onboarding doc for EdgeBank: steps to invite, sample prompt set, how to rotate keys, and how to request Dedicated if they scale. I'll draft it and drop in the customer folder.
Maria (sales): Awesome. Closing loop — thanks everyone. I'll update the CRM and attach NDA + onboarding doc when ready. :tada:
Tom (eng-infra): Done with the invites and key provisioning. LMK if they need a longer expiry. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Updated ticket INFR-4821 status -> in_progress
Maria (sales): Great, closing the loop here. If EdgeBank asks about RBAC nuances (workspace vs org roles), we'll schedule a short runbook call.
Jason (sales-engineer): I'll stand by for the capacity PR if they decide Dedicated.
Elaine (security): I'll review final onboarding doc once ready.
Maria (sales): Thanks team!
